title: Hand-over
intro: You are with {name}. Open the parcel, check it, then confirm.
introNoName: Open the parcel in front of the Shipper, check it, then confirm.
checklistWhy: You declare you have seen the contents. This is what protects you if you are checked.

items.CONTENT_MATCHES: The contents match what was declared
items.WEIGHT_OK: The weight looks consistent with the declaration ({weight} kg)
items.NO_FORBIDDEN: No prohibited item is present (weapons, drugs, counterfeits…)
items.PACKAGING_OK: The packaging is sound and the parcel can travel safely
items.ITEMS_IDENTIFIED: I have seen and identified every item in the parcel

photosWhy: From 1 to 5 photos. They count as evidence if the parcel is disputed on arrival.
notesPlaceholder: What you want on the record

missing.points: {count, plural, one {# check left} other {# checks left}}
missing.notes: Your note is {count} characters too long

afterBody: The Shipper receives their delivery code. The recipient will give it to you at hand-over.
refuseBody: The Shipper is fully refunded and you are not penalised. Tell us why, if you want.
failed: This action is not possible right now.
permissionCameraBody: Allow the camera to take photos of the parcel.
permissionLibraryBody: Allow access to your photos to pick one.
loadError: This request cannot be read right now.
wrongRole: This booking is read from the Shipper's side.
notAllowedBody: This parcel is not waiting to be taken. Go back to the request to see where it stands.
dealChanged: This request has changed in the meantime. Go back to read it again.
itemWeightUnknown: The weight looks consistent with the declaration

uploadErrors.INVALID_TYPE: Format not accepted — JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP.
uploadErrors.FAILED: Upload failed. Tap the photo to try again.
